instruction:
Background: The local kind cluster `demo`, in namespace `demo`, has a Helm release named `demo`. The warmup has already advanced it to at least 2 revisions — rev1 installed successfully, while rev2 was rejected by K8s during `helm upgrade` (with the error `Deployment.apps "demo" is invalid: spec.selector: ... field is immutable`). However, the Pod is still running 1/1 under the old spec, so the issue is not visible by only looking at the live runtime state. KUBECONFIG is already configured, and the chart source code lives at `/tmp_workspace/exec/broken-chart/`.

Goal: Deliver a complete incident forensics + remediation package from an SRE's perspective, explaining **which field the upgrade changed, why K8s refuses to allow the change, and how the fix PR should be written**. All deliverables must be written under `/tmp_workspace/results/`. **You are not allowed to use `helm rollback` to flatten the history and call it done** — the release's maximum revision number must remain ≥ 2, and the last revision's status must not be `deployed`. **Do not copy any file from `/tmp_workspace/gt/` into `results/`**.

### Hard constraints for the main deliverable `helm_history.json`

- JSON array, length ≥ 2;
- The last revision's `status` must be in {`failed`, `pending-upgrade`, `pending_upgrade`, `superseded`} (i.e. not `deployed`).

### Hard constraints for the main deliverable `immutable_diffs.json`

- Top-level shape `{"diffs":[ ... ]}`, with at least 1 entry in `diffs`;
- Each entry must be shaped like `{"kind":"Deployment","name":"demo","path":"spec.selector.matchLabels.app","from":"...","to":"..."}`;
- **Every** `path` must fall within the K8s immutable-field whitelist (prefix must belong to `spec.selector.matchLabels` / `spec.clusterIP` / `spec.serviceName` / `spec.volumeClaimTemplates.` / `spec.template.spec.containers.resources`); putting mutable fields such as `replicas` / `image` here will be counted as false positives and penalized;
- At least 1 `path` must contain `matchLabels`.

### Hard constraints for the main deliverable `critical_event.txt`

- A single line of original text that must contain `field is immutable`, `selector`, and at least one of `Deployment` or `apps/v1`.

### Hard constraints for the main deliverable `postmortem.md`

- ≥ 300 characters;
- Must cross-reference all 4 categories of evidence: (a) revision number; (b) the specific field-path keyword (`spec.selector` / `matchLabels` / `selector` / `clusterIP`); (c) the key `immutable` message; (d) a remediation-strategy keyword (one of `patch` / `diff` / `uninstall`).

### Supporting deliverables (under `/tmp_workspace/results/`)

| File | Requirement |
|---|---|
| `manifest_rev1.yaml` | Complete K8s manifest rendered from rev1, ≥ 20 non-empty lines |
| `manifest_rev2.yaml` | Target manifest of rev2 (the failed release), ≥ 20 non-empty lines |
| `manifest_rev1_rev2.diff` | Unified diff between the two manifests, ≥ 6 non-empty lines |
| `events.json` | Events list for namespace `demo`, with at least one entry whose reason/message hits `immutable` / `FailedCreate` / `FieldImmutable` / `field is immutable` |
| `fix_chart.patch` | Unified-diff format fix patch, ≥ 12 non-empty lines, containing `--- ` / `+++ ` headers and `@@` hunks, targeting `broken-chart/templates/deployment.yaml`, with the text containing one of `selector` / `matchLabels` / `helm.sh/resource-policy`. Pick any one fix strategy: restore the old value of the immutable field; or `uninstall + install` (with `helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`); or an equivalent `helm upgrade --force` approach |
| `post_fix_diff.txt` | Diff output between the fixed chart and the current cluster state (e.g. comparing `helm template` against live state), ≥ 200 characters, with ≥ 4 diff-marker lines (`+`/`-`/`@@`/`<`/`> `), and mentioning `Deployment` / `selector` / `matchLabels` |

### 5 in-process screenshots (under `/tmp_workspace/results/`, fixed file names)

Each must be a real screenshot at resolution ≥ 800×600 and file size ≥ 60 KB; OCR will be performed, so the corresponding resource view content must be clearly visible.

| File name | Required content |
|---|---|
| `view_01_headlamp_workloads.png` | Workloads/Deployments list view filtered to namespace `demo` |
| `view_02_headlamp_events.png` | Events panel for the `demo` Deployment, ≥ 3 event rows, with at least one row whose reason column indicates the failure cause |
| `view_03_headlamp_manifest_yaml.png` | YAML view of the current manifest of the `demo` Deployment, scrolled to the `spec.selector` / `matchLabels` section |
| `view_04_headlamp_replicaset.png` | ReplicaSet list for the `demo` Deployment, with both rev1 and rev2 ReplicaSets visible at the same time; the rev2 row shows desired/ready as 0 or NOT READY |
| `view_05_headlamp_after_fix.png` | Workloads/Deployments view after the fix, with the new ReplicaSet ready |

parameters.warmup:
set +e
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
mkdir -p /tmp_workspace/results /tmp_workspace/state /opt/ops11_gt
for i in $(seq 1 30); do [ -d /tmp_workspace/exec ] && break; sleep 1; done
which curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 120 apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=10 update -qq || true
which curl >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 300 apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=10 install -y -qq curl ca-certificates || true
which kubectl >/dev/null 2>&1 || (timeout 120 curl -sSL -o /usr/local/bin/kubectl https://dl.k8s.io/release/v1.30.0/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubectl) || true
which helm >/dev/null 2>&1 || (timeout 120 curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash) || true
which kind >/dev/null 2>&1 || (timeout 120 curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/kind https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/dl/v0.23.0/kind-linux-amd64 && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kind) || true
which headlamp >/dev/null 2>&1 || (timeout 180 curl -sSL -o /usr/local/bin/headlamp https://github.com/headlamp-k8s/headlamp/releases/latest/download/Headlamp-linux-x86_64.AppImage && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/headlamp) || true
which docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && (kind get clusters 2>/dev/null | grep -q demo || timeout 180 kind create cluster --name demo --wait 60s || true) || echo "[warmup] docker engine not present in VM; kind cluster bring-up skipped (best-effort)"
which docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && (kubectl get ns demo >/dev/null 2>&1 || kubectl create ns demo || true) || true
which docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && (helm history demo -n demo >/dev/null 2>&1 || { timeout 120 helm install demo /tmp_workspace/exec/broken-chart -n demo --set selectorLabel=demo --wait || true; timeout 120 helm upgrade demo /tmp_workspace/exec/broken-chart -n demo --set selectorLabel=demo-v2 --wait || true; }) || true
ls /tmp_workspace/exec/ || true
# Move expected.json (contains fix_hint solution sketch + event keywords)
# to root-only /opt/ops11_gt so the agent cannot grep the answer.
if [ -f /tmp_workspace/gt/expected.json ]; then
  mv /tmp_workspace/gt/expected.json /opt/ops11_gt/expected.json 2>/dev/null || true
  chown -R root:root /opt/ops11_gt 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 700 /opt/ops11_gt 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod 600 /opt/ops11_gt/expected.json 2>/dev/null || true
  rmdir /tmp_workspace/gt 2>/dev/null || true
fi
echo "[warmup] OPS_task_11 best-effort done (docker engine required for full task; flagged in FIX_LOG_OPS_WARMUP2.md)"

evaluator.desc: Run the WeaveBench rule-based grade() inside the VM and parse its REWARD score.
